title: Ten-sided polynomial tag decoding with 4 entries per side and cached interpolation contributions and column-prefix pair caps with single-mask summed distances and both individual distance cutoffs

claims.statement: The fixed product of four [500,250] components with length-ten polynomial tags and 4 relative-list entries per side has average block error at most 488500391007747921/500000000000000000 on the 2000-use BSC(1/10) for uniform 1000-bit data, when decoded by the counted program in proof.md.
The same bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=24821064 primitives for every received word and W<=2^(2456507/100000).

experiments.purpose: Verify local spectra and exact pair overlap profiles, including both distance cutoffs for support six through nine. The fourth run also checks the exact error and RAM counts.
